description: Search for datasets across all Socrata-powered government open-data portals, or scope to one portal with the domain parameter. Returns dataset IDs, names, domains, update timestamps, and column_names — the API field names SoQL takes, not display labels. Use socrata_get_dataset to fetch the typed column schema before writing queries — column_names carry no type information.

categories.description: Filter by domain categories (e.g. ["Public Safety", "Transportation"]). Multiple values are ORed: a dataset in any listed category matches.

domain.description: Scope search to a single portal by bare hostname (e.g. data.seattle.gov, data.cityofnewyork.us); URL forms like https://data.seattle.gov/ are accepted and reduced to the host. Omit to search all portals.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–10,000). One call returns at most 100 results: a larger limit is served as 100, with a notice naming the offset that continues. Default 10.

offset.description: Pagination offset. Default 0. Must be below 10,000: the Discovery catalog serves only the first 10,000 matches of a search.

only.description: Filter by asset type. Omit to include all types. Usually "datasets" is what you want.

order.description: Sort order. Defaults to relevance. Use updated_at to surface recently-refreshed datasets.

query.description: Full-text search across dataset names and descriptions. Omit to browse without filtering.

tags.description: Filter by tags (e.g. ["covid19", "permits"]). Multiple values are ORed: a dataset carrying any listed tag matches.

name: socrata_find_datasets

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `result_window_exceeded`: offset is 10,000 or more: the Discovery catalog serves only the first 10,000 matches of a search. `rate_limited`: Discovery API returned 429. `unknown_domain`: The Discovery catalog does not index the domain ("Domain not found"). `invalid_domain`: The domain is not a hostname, even after dropping a URL scheme, path, or query. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The Discovery API did not answer within the 50-second time limit the call shares across its requests, retries included. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance for this page. When limit was served below the requested value (the 100-result per-call cap or the 10,000-match window), names the served limit and where paging continues; when results are empty, echoes the filters and suggests how to broaden, or, when offset passed the last match, names the offset to page below. Absent otherwise.

results.description: Matching datasets. Empty when no results.

column_names.description: API field names — the identifiers SoQL takes in select/where/group/order (e.g. cuisine_description), not display labels. Computed-region system columns are dropped; empty when the catalog lists no field names. No type info — call socrata_get_dataset for the typed schema.

data_updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last data update when available.

dataset_id.description: Four-by-four dataset ID (e.g. kzjm-xkqj). Pass to socrata_get_dataset or socrata_query_dataset.

domain.description: Portal domain hosting this dataset (e.g. data.seattle.gov).

totalCount.description: Total matches before pagination. 0 when empty. Discovery counts no further than 10,000: when totalCountCapped is true, 10,000 is a lower bound.

totalCountCapped.description: True when totalCount reached Discovery's 10,000-match count ceiling, so more datasets may match than totalCount says. Absent otherwise.

title: Find Socrata Datasets
